source: Official API price pages, standard tier, short context, no caching or batch discount, accessed 2026-10-19 (same table as the thesis cost comparison, Ch. 8; experiments/locality/scripts/cost_comparison.py)
notes: Hosted cost = (input tokens + instruction) x input price + judge output tokens x output price; output tokens are the local judge's when it ran, else 4.15 per sentence (terse judge, thesis measurement). Local cost = GroundOne seconds x 16.2 W (thesis energy measurement: 33.1 J per answer at 2.04 s) x EUR 0.2896/kWh (Eurostat), converted at 1.08 USD/EUR. Hardware not amortised; hosted judge quality not measured.
